ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the Star Distribution's involvement in the Feeding Our Future fraud case, including the owner’s guilty plea and potential connections to other entities.
ideas.angle: Follow the money: track the flow of funds in the Feeding Our Future program and identify potential recipients and accomplices.
questions: What was the extent of Star Distribution's involvement?
Who else was involved in the fraud scheme?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud scheme involving government funds and multiple entities.

ideas.title: The ActBlue Investigation: Campaign Finance Irregularities?
ideas.description: Investigate the federal investigation into Democrats' ActBlue fundraising platform, including potential wrongdoing and large sums of money.
ideas.angle: Analyze campaign finance data to identify potential irregularities and connections to other entities.
questions: What are the allegations against ActBlue?
How widespread is the potential wrongdoing?
ideas.insight: This story could reveal potential wrongdoing in campaign finance and shed light on the inner workings of ActBlue.
